summary: Indonesia Energy Corp Ltd filed a Form 424B5 prospectus supplement to increase the maximum amount of ordinary shares it may sell under an existing at-the-market (ATM) offering agreement with H.C. Wainwright. The filing registers the offer and sale of up to $14.1 million of shares, reflecting a routine shelf takedown adjustment due to General Instruction I.B.5 of Form F-3. No special-situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, or restructuring is involved; this is a standard capital-raising update.
